guidelines.detail: refines FID-02 (The description identifies distinct assessment dimensions, while the records show that corresponding testing activities were not represented separately. This refines FID-02 by specifying when separately described criteria should be modeled as separate activities.)
same as LRN-003 (The description specifies what the idea is for, but the generated label omits that meaningful qualifier. LRN-003 already states this guideline.)

refines FID-01 (The description gives distinct terminal outcomes, including discarding the prototype, while the generated model lacks the corresponding task and branch. This refines the general requirement to model every stated activity and outcome by clarifying how to represent an outcome achieved through an action.)

refines FID-03 (The generated labels add actor, object, or implementation context to actions that remain clear without those additions in context. This specifies how to apply the documented preference for short, faithful labels without discarding meaningful qualifiers.)

same as LRN-010 (The description identifies several tests and subsequent shared feedback work. The missing and extra flows show that the generated model ordered the tests sequentially instead of branching and synchronizing them before feedback. This guideline is already essentially stated by learned guideline LRN-010.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies multiple distinct criteria for evaluating an item: Model each criterion as a distinct assessment activity rather than subsuming them in one generic assessment activity.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies multiple distinct criteria for evaluating an item

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description specifies an activity’s object, recipient, or other meaningful qualifier: Preserve that qualifier in the BPMN task label rather than replacing it with a broader paraphrase.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description specifies an activity’s object, recipient, or another meaningful qualifier

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies alternative terminal outcomes and states an action associated with at least one outcome: Model each outcome on its own branch, representing any stated action that realizes an outcome as a task before a terminal end event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies alternative terminal outcomes and states an action associated with at least one outcome

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description gives an activity together with contextual or explanatory details that are not needed to distinguish the activity in its process context: Label the BPMN task with its core action and necessary object, omitting redundant contextual modifiers while preserving details essential to the activity’s meaning.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description gives an activity together with contextual or explanatory details that are not needed to distinguish the activity in its process context

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states that several activities are all required before a later activity or outcome: Model the activities as parallel branches and synchronize all branches with a parallel gateway before the later activity or outcome.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description specifies multiple distinct evaluations of the same item that must all finish before common subsequent work
